messages:
maria: Quick brainstorm — which 3 charts do we lead with for the benchmark launch to sell the latency → cost story? Keep it simple for the landing page and a deeper set for the webinar.
kevin: my high-level pick: 1) scatter of tail-latency vs $/1k tokens by model variant, 2) stacked area of tokens served vs effective $/token over time, 3) small-multiples of p95 across slices (short/long seq). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
olga: +1 to the scatter. for messaging we should call out "predictable latency bands" vs just averages. SMB copy = "fast, cheap enough". Enterprise copy = "SLO-backed, cost controls".
devon: webinar hook idea: "3 tradeoffs we tuned to cut per-token spend 40-60% without breaking p95" — then show a short case: dev sandbox -> dedicated -> private fallback.
maria: love the webinar hook. for the landing hero we need one clear visual: maybe simplified scatter with a highlighted vertical band "our sweet spot" and a short blurb.
kevin: for the scatter UI/UX, call out these interactions: hover to see model, quantization, batch config; toggle to compare cold vs warmed KV cache. keeps it tangible.
sam: inbound routing question — what lead form fields do we need to qualify trials from the benchmark page? I suggest: expected qps, latency SLO, data sensitivity, region, team size. route high-SLO & high-qps to @sales-enterprise, others to self-serve nurture.
olga: also add "primary use case" with options: search, chat, embeddings, rerank — helps match model recommendations.
bench-bot: perf-scan complete — sample slices: search-short(128), chat-long(2048), ri-longtail(4096) — attach CSV at /shared/bench/3932100000.csv
kevin: visual notes: small-multiple p95s should use consistent color for model families, not for deployment type. deployment type can be an annotation layer. keeps charts readable.
maria: copy snippets for hero: "Predictable inference that saves you money — latency you trust, cost you control." webinar CTA: "See the charts, ask the team: Thu 11am PT" :sparkles:
devon: ops ask — can we include a short code snippet for reproducibility? e.g.,
```
# run a microbench
bench run --model redwood-3b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --cache warm
```
keep it tiny in the blog so engs can eyeball.
kevin: targeting: landing page needs 3 CTAs: 1) Try demo (self-serve), 2) Book enterprise consult, 3) Register webinar. each CTA should set a utm + routing tag.
maria: routing tags: utm_campaign=bench_launch, utm_segment={self-serve|enterprise|webinar}. pass tag to CRM so @growth can automate nurture.
sam: noted — I'll map tags to lead queues and set up an alert for >10 enterprise leads/day.
olga: design asks: prefer muted palette, highlight our green for the "sweet spot" band. also need a 30s GIF that animates the scatter growing and the cost curve falling.
kevin: metric framing for copy: show absolute $/1k tokens for a few representative prompts (search 50tks/session, chat 800tks/session) — avoids abstract %. people want dollars.
maria: final checklist before doc gets to design: chart csv + axis labels, hero copy, 30s gif brief, webinar blurb, lead-form fields, CRM routing table. who picks this up?
sam: i'll own CRM routing + lead form.
kevin: i'll hand off chart CSV + viz specs.
devon: i'll draft webinar blurb and the reproducible microbench gist.
olga: i'll own hero copy + GIF brief.
maria: perfect — target to hand to design by EOD Friday. if anyone needs to pivot messaging for legal/compliance, flag now. :thumbsup:
kevin: quick note — avoid benchmarking claims like "50% cheaper" without the a/b context. use ranges and examples.
maria: agreed. we'll use phrasing like "typical case: 30–60% lower $/token vs naive serving setups" and link to appendix.
bench-bot: reminder scheduled: upload final CSVs at 3932100200.
maria: thanks team — syncing in #launchsprint tomorrow 10am to review assets.
